spans.s:
Su-yajña Śāṇḍilya is the name of a pupil of Kaṃsa Vārakya
in the Jaiminīya Upaniṣad Brāhmaṇa (iv. 17, 1). Another
Suyajña is a Śāṅkhāyana, author of the Gṛhya Sūtra.

Su-yavasa denotes a ‘good pasture’ in the Rigveda^1 and
later.^2
1) i. 42, 8; vi. 28, 7; vii. 18, 4, etc.
2) Taittirīya Saṃhitā, i. 7, 5, 2, etc.
